name: SP2 Stage 4 — Catalog enrichment and coverage analysis

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-01 ICA with prompt injection keywords maps to ATLAS and OWASP

steps.text: an ICA with ica_text containing prompt injection and loss_scenario containing attacker manipulates
at least one mapping has catalog ATLAS
at least one mapping has catalog OWASP_AGENTIC

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-02 ICA with no matching keywords is unmapped

steps.text: an ICA with ica_text containing routine status check and loss_scenario containing no attack vector

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-03 confidence level depends on keyword match count

steps.text: an ICA with ica_text containing <keyword_1> and <keyword_2>

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-04 N/A reconciliation flags contradiction when catalog matches N/A slot

steps.text: an N/A slot with na_justification no hazard applicable
the control action description contains prompt injection
a contradiction flag is raised for the slot

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-05 N/A reconciliation passes when no catalog match for N/A slot

steps.text: an N/A slot with na_justification action is atomic and stateless
the control action description contains routine validation
no contradiction flag is raised for the slot

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-06 coverage analysis produces three-way partition

steps.text: an ICA enumeration with 10 total slots, 7 non-N/A and 3 N/A
4 non-N/A ICAs have catalog mappings and 3 do not

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-07 coverage analysis partitions by ICA type

steps.text: an ICA enumeration with 4 NOT_PROVIDED ICAs, 3 INCORRECT ICAs, 1 WRONG_TIMING ICA, and 0 WRONG_DURATION ICAs

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-08 coverage analysis partitions by controller

steps.text: an ICA enumeration with 5 ICAs from RESP-1, 3 ICAs from RESP-2, and 2 ICAs from CL-1

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-09 structural consideration metric counts considered slots

steps.text: an ICA enumeration with 10 total slots where 7 have ICAs and 3 are N/A with justification

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-10 N/A quality metric counts structural keyword citations

steps.text: an ICA enumeration with 4 N/A slots where 3 have structural keywords in na_justification

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-11 uncovered OWASP threats are listed

steps.text: an ICA enumeration where no ICA matches OWASP threat T10 or T15

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-12 catalog enrichment makes no LLM calls

steps.text: an ICA enumeration with 5 non-N/A ICAs and 2 N/A slots

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-13 structural threats carry provenance structural

steps.text: an ICA enumeration with 3 non-N/A ICAs
enriched threat set is built from the ICA enumeration
every structural threat has provenance structural
the number of structural threats equals the number of non-N/A ICAs

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-14 N/A reconciliation flags are recorded in coverage analysis

steps.text: an ICA enumeration with 1 N/A slot that has a catalog contradiction
catalog enrichment and coverage analysis are computed
the coverage analysis na_reconciliation_flags has 1 entry

scenarios.name: SP2-CAT-15 enriched threat set validates against the EnrichedThreatSet schema

steps.text: an ICA enumeration with 2 non-N/A ICAs and 1 N/A slot
enriched threat set is built from the ICA enumeration
the enriched threat set validates successfully

background.text: the SP2 catalog enrichment module is importable
the SP2 coverage module is importable
